items.s: Every part is described three ways so you can redraw it in any CAD program:
at pattern with ordinate dimensions for bend lines,
2) coordinate tables (outline corners V, features, bend lines),
3) enlarged details of corners, reliefs, tabs and slots + folded cross-sections with outside dimensions.
The same numbers are in the CSV
les (one per part) if you prefer to import or paste them.
hex wave pattern: rule + all 360 hex centres
Material 1.2 mm CRS or galvanised steel. Units mm. Coordinates to 2 decimals (CSV has 3).
ORIGIN 0,0 of each part = lower-left corner of that part's
at-pattern bounding box. X to the right, Y up.
V1, all straight segments (no arcs in outlines).
SLOT = obround, size = overall length × width @ angle from +X (CCW +).
WINDOW = rounded rectangle, size = W × H, corner radius R.
KEYHOLE = Ø10 circle + 5 wide slot, 12 travel upward from Ø10 centre.
at is folded: inside R1.2, K-factor 0.42, bend deduction 2.12 mm per 90°.
Flat pattern lengths: segment between two bends = outside dim
Body: bends UP (toward viewer, drawing is the inside face).
Cover & plate: drawing is the outside/front face.
General tolerance: laser ±0.2, bent dims ±0.5, angles ±1°.
